snippet.title: Don't Die Trailer
snippet.description:
Don’t Die is a casual yet strategic roguelike played with Dice. Defeat monsters, upgrade your dice, and build game-breaking combos that defy the odds. But most importantly, Don’t Die.

Launches worldwide for free, no download required Feb 23, 2026 with continual updates
